items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Mildred had worked out in Detroit with Irving Aaronson's Commanders

ctx.x: So then that winter, it was that winter? Yes, I think it was that Fall. They opened the Famous Door and they wanted me to go in there. With the band. Now Mildred had worked out in Detroit with Irving Aaronson's Commanders --
